lean.statement: For every finite index type iota, probability measure mu and measure pi on EuclideanSpace real iota, sigma-finite mu, a Lebesgue-decomposition instance, linear generator L, real C, an LSI witness SatisfiesLogSobolev pi L C, canonical-density LogSobolevAdmissible, a SmoothFiniteScoreDomain for mu relative to pi, a canonical DirichletPairDomain and HasCanonicalFisherGamma, the Mathlib divergence klDiv mu pi is not infinity and its real value is at most (C/2) times CanonicalRelativeFisher.information mu pi.
approved_definition_context: SatisfiesLogSobolev pi L C means pi is a probability measure, C is positive, and every LogSobolevAdmissible nonnegative normalized density rho satisfies densityEntropy pi rho at most C divided by two times dirichletForm pi L rho (log rho).
LogSobolevAdmissible records integrability and normalization of rho, integrability of rho times log rho, and integrability of rho times L(log rho).
SmoothFiniteScoreDomain records absolute continuity, almost-everywhere differentiability of the canonical log Radon--Nikodym ratio, and integrability of its squared score under the left measure.
DirichletPairDomain and HasCanonicalFisherGamma are explicit integration-by-parts, symmetry, stationarity, integrability and carre-du-champ contracts for the canonical density and log-density pair.
CanonicalRelativeFisher.information is the integral under the left measure of the squared gradient of the canonical log Radon--Nikodym ratio on its guarded smooth finite domain.
Mathlib klDiv is ENNReal-valued; toReal sends infinity to zero, so a separate not-infinity conclusion is mathematically significant.
